items.computation: Letter dated Monday 01.09.2025, sent by ordinary post by an authority. Under the deemed-delivery rule (§ 41 Abs. 2 VwVfG, 4 days since 2025), it counts as delivered on the 4th day after posting: Friday 05.09.2025. The one-month Widerspruch period (§ 70 VwGO) starts the following day under § 187 Abs. 1 BGB and ends one month later, on Sunday 05.10.2025 (§ 188 Abs. 2 BGB). Since that day is a Sunday, the deadline shifts to the next business day, Monday 06.10.2025 (§ 31 Abs. 3 VwVfG / § 57 Abs. 2 VwGO with § 222 Abs. 2 ZPO).
